automation_evidence.quote:
present an active learning framework for detecting anomalies in samples of periodic variable stars,
with the vetting delegated to multimodal large language model agents.

metric_evidence.quote: At the same labeling budget, the initial ranking would have recovered only 30% of our catalog,

evidence.quote:
therefore increased the purity of the anomaly sample
(fraction passing our inspection) by a factor of ∼2.

practical_problems.note: five-agent majority review demoted 23 of 43 single-agent anomalies; authors manually inspected demoted and surviving sources and measured purity

evidence.quote:
We applied quality cuts to remove sparsely observed
and noise-dominated sources with fewer than 50 observations or magnitude ranges ∆m > 15 mag,

practical_problems.note: artifact false positives and quality cuts are handled by prompts and filters; no experiment varies noise or sampling

summary: Delegates anomaly vetting of 373,646 ASAS-SN light curves to Gemini agents inside an active learning loop; it recovers more of the catalog than the initial ranking at equal budget, and the consensus review roughly doubles sample purity by the authors' own inspection.
